purpose: Implement reviewable/correctable demonstrated Skill evidence so N0TE remembers what the artist has explicitly introduced, practiced, applied or performed independently without inferring competence from rough Session scratch or note volume.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect and correct a persistent skill level grounded in explicit real-work evidence, while scratch and creative taste remain separate and inert.
lineage.capability: Reviewable/correctable skill-state evidence grounded in real Song work

legacy_candidates: learning/skill semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: Session scratch and ordinary EvidenceMemory inserts do not create or advance a Skill assessment; absence remains UNKNOWN
INTRODUCED is recorded only by an explicit append-only assessment with source provenance
non-artist PRACTICED/APPLIED/INDEPENDENT assessments require an owned CLOSED Session
Session-bound Song/Version evidence from another Song cannot ground a Skill assessment
INDEPENDENT is rejected unless assistance_level is explicitly zero
artist correction can move the level up, down or back to UNKNOWN with a reason while preserving every earlier assessment
assessment evidence links and Skill history are append-only and corruption guards validate required triggers/bindings on reopen
foreign-profile Session IDs and missing evidence claims are rejected
restart preserves assessment order, current state and evidence provenance
SKILL_ASSESSED journals into canonical Activity without creating or modifying creative EvidenceMemory claims
repeated Skill state/history reads perform zero canonical writes
non_scope: automatic inference from Session scratch or note volume
Artist World taste or creative-intent mutation
next_selection_rule: After CORE-02B evidence, reconcile and globally compare remaining CORE-02 experiment/friction/success outcomes against preserved CORE-03 capability-fact/profile/template work. Do not grow Skill heuristics or teaching UI by adjacency.
